in_sanskrit.name: सिद्धार्थ
in_sanskrit.meaning: He who has reached his goal, or perfected in worldly matters

in_hindi.name: सिद्धार्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: जीवनीय कार्यों में सफल होने वाला

in_marathi.name: Siddhartha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achiever of Goals
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddhartha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has accomplished, attained or achieved his goals.

in_bengali.name: Siddhartha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Achiever of Goals
in_bengali.long_meaning: Siddhartha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has accomplished, attained or achieved his goals.
